membership_note: LAUNCH policy for the four launch Challenges, named by the validator's own Challenge ids (electric-motor-magnetics, chip-cold-plate, f08-ribbed-bracket, f02), N = 4, 1/N each, remainder to burn UID 0, netuid 567. v2 and v3 name Ribbed Bracket 'f08', which the validator never emits, so a pool store registered under its real id is SOURCE_OUTSIDE_POLICY there; this version fixes the id and changes nothing else (decay, cadence, burn, baselines null / first-incumbent rule, self_improvement_factor null). Not the registry's current policy; the standing authorization names its digest only when the owner approves it. A crown still needs a registered rebuild noise (koth_rebuild_noise.json); until then every epoch burns to UID 0.
